example_limits: New canonical request-coalescing article, with Singleflight and Request Collapsing as qualified searchable names. No existing exact article found; existing cache-aside, memoization, batching and timeout IDs/homes reused as related links. Single primary home Performance and Scalability as sixth member. Original price-reader scenario and complete Python3.11+ real asyncio implementation, using one Coalescer instance on one event loop and default deferred task scheduling. Trusted immutable hashable keys encode operation identity within a loader namespace; demo tuple tenant-A/SKU-7/USD/version3. Immutable result1200USD cents. A starts event-gated load1; B/C join; B cancels its wait while shield keeps load1 alive; A/C return1200 withloads1; later same-key call performs load2 because completed results are not cached. Registry retains strong task references, observes ordinary errors even if no waiter remains, identity-guards cleanup, bypasses done entries pending callbacks, and propagates load failures/cancellation to remaining waits. close rejects new get calls and drains shielded owned tasks. No network/cache/auth implementation, explicit capacity limits, loader deadline, all-waiters-left cancellation, cross-thread/loop or distributed coordination. Loader must not recursively await its own flight or rely on hidden request-specific context. A stuck loader can block drain. HTTP proxy eligibility context is explanatory, not executed. Original program/scenarios/cancellation experiment and native diagrams are teaching material.
